title: Cultural Palette: Pluralising Culture Alignment via Multi-agent Palette
reasoning: The paper features a qualitative evaluation component (Section C.1 and Tables 3 and 4) that specifically benchmarks and evaluates the model's ability to handle spiritual traditions and religious concepts (e.g., reincarnation, heaven/hell, ancestor worship, and Nordic Valhalla) across various cultures. Additionally, it addresses cultural values and ethical trade-offs, such as freedom versus equality.
